# Interface route

The behaviors that route calls, and each call that its examples make.
`osapi behavior chain get --name route` shows the same.

## Chain

|          |                                                              |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Behavior | [route](../../behaviors/networking/interface/route/route.md) |
| Chain    | route → netplan → managedfile                                |
| Calls    | [netplan](../../behaviors/internal/netplan/netplan.md)       |
| Used by  | none                                                         |

## A route (create)

| CALL                    | SENDS                                                                                  | GETS                                                      |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| route create            | destination=198.51.100.0/24 name=osapi0 via=192.0.2.1                                  | changed=true destination=198.51.100.0/24                  |
| └─ netplan get          | name=osapi0                                                                            | id=osapi0 matches=\[osapi0] name=osapi0 section=ethernets |
| └─ netplan update       | content=&lt;7 lines&gt; metadata=&#123;"domain":"route","interface":"osapi0"&#125; pa… | changed=true path=/etc/netplan/osapi-osapi0-routes.yaml   |
| · └─ managedfile update | content=&lt;7 lines&gt; metadata=&#123;"domain":"route","interface":"osapi0"&#125; mo… | changed=true path=/etc/netplan/osapi-osapi0-routes.yaml   |
